description: Foundation: install new packages, add Inter font, page transitions, toast system, and progress bar. These are cross-cutting changes that every subsequent FEAT depends on. Removes stale dark-mode CSS from globals.css. Must be done first.
steps: Install pinned packages: `npm install recharts@2.12.7 next-view-transitions@0.3.2 nprogress@0.2.0 && npm install --save-dev @types/nprogress@0.2.3` — this updates package.json and package-lock.json

Edit src/app/globals.css: remove the .dark body/header/footer/nav blocks (lines starting with '.dark') — these are forbidden dark-mode classes. Add keyframe animations and view-transition CSS: `@keyframes fade-out { from { opacity: 1; } to { opacity: 0; } }`, `@keyframes fade-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }`, `::view-transition-old(root) { animation: fade-out 0.15s ease; }`, `::view-transition-new(root) { animation: fade-in 0.15s ease; }`
Edit tailwind.config.ts: add `fontFamily: { sans: ['var(--font-inter)', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif'] }` under theme.extend

Create src/components/ToastContext.tsx: 'use client' component exporting ToastProvider and useToast hook. ToastProvider manages a toasts state array and an optional confirmState. Provides success(msg), error(msg), info(msg), and confirm(msg):Promise<boolean> via context. Renders a fixed bottom-right toast stack and a modal confirm dialog. Toast items auto-dismiss after 4000ms. Use crypto.randomUUID() for IDs. Confirm dialog has Cancel and Confirm buttons. No dark: classes. Types: ToastVariant = 'success'|'error'|'info'; ToastItem = {id:string; message:string; variant:ToastVariant}; ToastCtx = {success,error,info,confirm}.

Create src/components/ProgressBar.tsx: 'use client' component that imports NProgress from 'nprogress' and 'nprogress/nprogress.css'. Calls NProgress.configure({ showSpinner: false, minimum: 0.15 }). Uses usePathname and useSearchParams from next/navigation. useEffect([pathname, searchParams]) calls NProgress.done(). Returns null. Must be wrapped in Suspense by the caller.

Edit src/app/layout.tsx: (a) Import Inter from next/font/google: `const inter = Inter({ subsets: ['latin'], variable: '--font-inter', display: 'swap' })`. (b) Import ViewTransitions from next-view-transitions. (c) Import ToastProvider from @/components/ToastContext. (d) Import ProgressBar from @/components/ProgressBar. (e) Import ServiceWorkerRegistration (will be created in FEAT-003 — stub it as null for now, or skip until FEAT-003). (f) Update and . (g) Wrap children: `{children}`. (h) Keep ~hysterical watermark span OUTSIDE ViewTransitions but inside body. Final body structure: `{children}~hysterical`

Edit src/components/PapersTable.tsx: import useToast from @/components/ToastContext. Replace all window.alert(...) calls with toast.error(...) or toast.success(...). Replace all window.confirm(...) calls with `await toast.confirm(...)` — change the surrounding function to async if not already.
Edit src/components/MessagesTable.tsx: same pattern — import useToast, replace window.alert/confirm.
Edit src/components/CoursesTable.tsx: same pattern — import useToast, replace window.alert/confirm.
Edit src/components/UploadForm.tsx: same pattern — import useToast, replace window.alert/confirm.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero TypeScript and ESLint errors
npm run test:unit passes all 30 existing tests
src/app/layout.tsx imports Inter font and ViewTransitions and ToastProvider
No dark: Tailwind utility classes appear anywhere in src/
verification: grep -r 'dark:' /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/src/ --include='*.tsx' --include='*.ts' --include='*.css' | grep -v node_modules | wc -l  # must be 0
findings: UploadForm.tsx had no window.alert/confirm calls — it already used inline error state (setErrorMessage), so no changes were needed there. MessagesTable.tsx had no window.confirm calls, only window.alert in toggleRead. CoursesTable.tsx had only window.confirm in handleDelete (errors go to rowError state). PapersTable.tsx had both alert and window.confirm in toggleStatus, deletePaper, bulkAction, and bulkDelete — all replaced. The watermark span was placed outside ViewTransitions but inside body as specified. NProgress.configure is called at module level (outside the component) to avoid re-running on every render.
